subject: numbat
title: This Marsupial Must Eat 20,000 Termites Every Single Day

scenes.text: This animal has no choice. It has to eat 20,000 termites a day.
The numbat is a small Australian marsupial that weighs less than a bag of sugar.
Its tongue is about four inches long, nearly half its body length, and it is sticky.
Unlike most marsupials, it hunts in daylight, waiting until termites warm up and start moving.
Today only two natural populations are left, both in Western Australia. Twenty thousand a day, and every one counts.
